canvas.$description: Canvas — Page background, card surfaces, primary surface for all content blocks

ink.$description: Ink — Hairline borders, icon strokes, fine dividers — the linework that structures the page

obsidian.$description: Obsidian — Primary text, heading text, filled CTA buttons, dark feature cards

graphite.$description: Graphite — Secondary text, link text, default link borders — slightly softer than Obsidian for body copy

smoke.$description: Smoke — Tertiary text, muted helper copy

ash.$description: Ash — Mid-gray borders and subdued supporting text

mist.$description: Mist — Subtle surface tint, muted block backgrounds, very light washes

glacier-tint.$description: Glacier Tint — Hero photograph cool wash, decorative ice-blue accent — appears only as a near-gray atmospheric tint, not a saturated brand color

almarai.$description: Display and heading — the only font that carries headlines. Weight 300 is anti-convention: most enterprise brands use 600-700 for authority, Almarai Light achieves authority through restraint. Combined with -0.02em tracking it reads like editorial print, not SaaS. Originated as an Arabic typeface, its Latin glyphs have a distinctive humanist geometry that no system font replicates exactly.

abc-diatype.$description: Body and running text. The workhorse — paragraphs, descriptions, card content. Neutral humanist sans that steps back to let the Almarai headlines lead.

abc-diatype-semi-mono.$description: Technical labels, nav items, tag text, links, caption-style metadata. The monospaced variant of Diatype gives the UI a quiet engineering voice — used to mark functional elements that should read as system, not editorial.

system-sans-serif.$description: Smallest utility text, browser-default contexts, fallback
